name: Tide of Bloodlust
body:
School illusion (pattern) [mind-affecting]; Level bloodlord 8, cleric/oracle 8, shaman 8, sorcerer/wizard 8, witch 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a weapon coated in blood)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 10-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a terrible field of violence and bloodlust.

The area affected by this emanation looks as though it is slick with blood. Any creature entering or beginning their turn in the area must make a Will save. On a failure, they are overcome with an irresistible need to kill or destroy the nearest creature. They must use the most deadly attack they have on the nearest creature, whether it be friend or foe. If the most deadly attack is an area effect one, it must be centered on the target.

Each round on your turn, you can move the emanation in a straight line up to 20 feet.
